description: Bitcoin only, beta. The newest changes of the published BTC signals the five-minute job logged in the last 30 days, newest first (the whole log is in the bulk files below): each timeframe's trend, direction, confidence and degenerate flag; the consensus counts; each thesis horizon's arms (action, probability, has_signal, degenerate), its most probable case and its dominant case (the highest-probability case with price levels, or none; the levels are not published), the tie and the aggregate confidence; the sentiment blend; funding; open interest (one contract, and summed by exchange); both fear and greed indexes; the news index. Each entry in `changes` gives the `signal`, its `timeframe` (a horizon for the thesis, null when it has none), the `field`, `old` and `new`, `changed_at` (when the run saw it), `snapshot_generated_at` and `input_at` (the value's own time: the analysis time, the bucket, the index's day). A row is written only when a value changes, with probabilities and confidences rounded to two places, so a run that saw no change wrote nothing. Filter by `signal` and `timeframe` and bound with `since` and `until` (clamped to the last 30 days); `limit` (up to 30) is how many of the newest rows to show, `count` is how many are shown, `more_in_bulk` is true when more match, and `withheld_rows` counts the stored rows it did not serve. The whole log is had in bulk, not paged: `bulk` gives the index of the UTC days in the window and each day's file, every row of that day, oldest first, as JSON. `freshness` says when the log was last checked, since when it has been kept (null while rows could not be stored), and its gaps: periods the log was not checked, after which a change is logged once, at the first run after the gap, or not at all if it was undone inside it. Until the owner turns the log on, `changes` is empty and freshness says it is not published. No price, entry, target or stop is logged or served. Not investment advice.

limit.description: How many of the newest rows to show; the whole log is in the bulk files.

signal.description: One signal; leave out for all of them.

since.description: ISO date or date-time, UTC; clamped to the last 30 days.

timeframe.description: A timeframe (the per-timeframe rows) or a thesis horizon (scalp, short, long); it implies the signal.

until.description: ISO date or date-time, UTC; a bare date is that whole day.
